rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Drop {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon DLL dropped in Temp directory"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 00 } // .rcd string common in beacon configs
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $https_c2 = "https://" fullword ascii
        $mutex = "Global\\\\MSCTF.Asm.{" ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $beacon_config and $http_get and $https_c2 and $mutex

arguments.summary: An APT actor compromised the workstation of a Finance department user (CORP\jsmith) via a phishing campaign involving malicious PowerShell execution from Outlook. The initial access led to the deployment of Cobalt Strike beaconing to an external C2 server (198.51.100.23). The threat actor performed internal reconnaissance, attempted lateral movement via SMB, and modified host files to enable persistence. Despite detection by IDS and EDR systems, containment actions were denied during the Admin phase, leaving the threat active on the network.
